candidate_status: Awaiting Tom's review · used in the family release

blender.animation_keys: Every frame, linear, exported without keyframe optimisation
blender.skin: One skin; rigid props plus smoothstep blends at the neck, waist, shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, ankles, fringe, tail, bow tails and swallowtails (at most 2 influences used)
blender.root: Identity, fixed floor-centred root; no root animation; the hips carry the bounce, lunge, spin and bow
blender.bind_pose: Neutral: head straight, arms in a 50 deg A-pose with a 40 deg elbow bend, feet forward, knees bent 3.5 cm (rest controls reproduce it, max matrix error 1.9e-05)
blender.sheet_pose: Idle at 0 s reproduces the blockout sheet pose (mic grille, mic fist, wrists and feet within 2.2e-07 m)

export.compression: None; no Draco, Meshopt or KTX2 requirement

preview.source: Exact delivered GLB via Three.js GLTFLoader
preview.renderer: Chromium headless ANGLE SwiftShader, real WebGL raster; no physical device claim
preview.stills_pose: Main stills: idle at 0 s (the sheet pose); rest-*.png: the bind pose
preview.lighting: Warm hemisphere plus three directional lights; ACES tone mapping exposure 1.0
